newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Southcorp buys Devil's Lair winery.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Southcorp buys Devil's Lair winery.

text.p: Wine, packaging and appliance manufacturer Southcorp Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had acquired the Devil's Lair winery in the Margaret River region in Western Australia for an undisclosed amount.

"We advise that the company has reached agreement to purchase the premium Margaret River winery, Devil's Lair. The transaction is expected to be completed in the New Year," the company said in a statement.
Southcorp said the purchase would provide it with access to another premium wine growing region and highly regarded brand.
Under the transaction Southcorp said it would obtain the Devil's Lair brands, all stock and an operating winery on a 127 hectare property, including 35 hectares of established vineyard.
"Devil's Lair is one of the leading super premium brands in the Margaret River region, with an annual production of 10,000 cases per year," said Southcorp Wines chief executive Bruce Kemp.
Southcorp said it would retain the Devil's Lair brands' identity and integrity and would look to use its resources and expertise to develop the business.

"Following successful conclusion of the purchase, we plan to fully develop the potential vineyard area over the next two years and, with the support of independent growers, to expand winery capacity to enable the brand to grow to 70,000 cases over the next five years," Kemp said.
At 12.50 p.m. (0150 GMT), Southcorp shares were two cents higher at A$3.92.
